content:
Looking at this PR, to what extend do we (as "mathlib") need to verify that external repos linked in 100.yaml (or 1000.yaml) actually formalise what they claim?

I think I see these yamls more like a progress report without much guarantees so would be happy to merge #41757 with only briefly glancing at the linked repo, but I wonder if there are other opinions?

announcement on Zulip about this

Weiyi Wang said:

I have the theorem that characterize constructible polygon at EuclideanGeometry.constructible_polygon. Of course, as previously mentioned, it doesn't contain the explicit construction due to ConstructiblePoint being a Prop.
btw I previously opened #41757 to link 100.yml to my repo. Thought I should mention it here
